subject: maths
question: One pipe can fill a tank in 6 minutes while another pipe can empty the completely filled tank in 24 minutes. If both the pipes are opened together when the tank is empty, how many minutes will it take to fill one-fourth of the tank?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Filling rate = 1/6, Emptying rate = 1/24

Net rate = 1/6 − 1/24 = 1/8

Time for full tank = 8 min

Time for 1/4 tank = 8 × 1/4 = 2 min

**∴ Answer = 2 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Pipe A fills tank in 6 min

Pipe B empties tank in 24 min

**Formula used:**

Total Work = LCM of 6 and 24 = 24 units

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time
